entities.summary: Davit Bek or David Beg was an Armenian military commander and the leader of an Armenian rebellion against the invading Ottoman Empire and implanted Safavid Muslim tribes in the mountainous region of Zangezur. He was one of the most prominent military figures of the Armenian liberation movement of the 18th century.
